:::: {.home-main}
::: {.lede}
I am a Postdoctoral Fellow at the University of Toronto, working with Dr. [Kuan Liu](https://www.kuan-liu.com/). Previously, I was a Postdoctoral Associate at the Yale School of Public Health, working with Dr. [Bhramar Mukherjee](https://ysph.yale.edu/profile/bhramar-mukherjee/). My research develops statistical methods that connect rigorous inference with practical questions in public health, epidemiology, and ecology.
:::

## Research interests

My current work focuses on using Bayesian causal inference methods to explore the effect of extreme weather on health outcomes. I am also interested in capture–recapture methods, population size estimation, data integration, and latent variable models.

<ul class="interest-list">
  <li>Bayesian inference</li>
  <li>Capture-recapture</li>
  <li>Causal inference</li>
  <li>Latent factor modeling</li>
  <li>Data integration</li>
  <li>Statistical ecology</li>
</ul>
:::
